messages.message:
Patch Set 1:

(10 comments)

Experimental feature testing in progress, please pay attention to the comments

Some concerns, see inline comments. The core question is whether dropping WQ_UNBOUND is the right way to shed apply_workqueue_attrs(): an unbound workqueue plus queue_work_on() would give the same partition affinity without collapsing every queue onto a single CPU, and without changing what max_active means. Since this is a measurable behavior change to readahead, the pinger, zombie reaping and LNet selftest, an lnet-selftest and a client read-throughput comparison before/after would help justify it.
